faq_heading: Sullivan Station condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Sullivan Station. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sullivan Station, Surrey: 128 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 15 Surrey communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Sullivan Station fell from 147 in June to 128 in September (−12.9%), and 84 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 8.4% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Sullivan Station?
Sullivan Station also had 93 houses listed and 6 sold in September, against 128 condos and townhomes listed. The Sullivan Station houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Sullivan Station home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

180 townhomes sold in Sullivan Station with a median price of $785,000 (the middle half sold between $720,000 and $850,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $486 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $366 a month. 5 condos sold in Sullivan Station with a median price of $574,000, taking a median of 23 days to sell at 96.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $565 per square foot, a median year built of 2013 and a median strata fee of $454 a month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sullivan Station
Viva (Viva Living / Viva Sullivan Ridge) — 14398 60 Avenue

A 4-storey mixed-use building by Four Square Properties at 60 Avenue & 144 Street: the presale record states 71 condominiums and five retail units, with interiors by The Collaborative Design Studio. Completion timing conflicts between sources: the presale record gave an expected completion of March 2025, a later project information packet gave an estimated completion of January 2026, the building directory records Viva as built in 2025, and current listings record a 2026 build year — exact completion year UNCONFIRMED; treat the building as newly completed and verify the specific unit's status (developer sale vs resale) before relying on GST/REDMA treatment. A current listing records pets: Yes. Any other published rental/pet/age restrictions: UNCONFIRMED.
Latitude — 14358 60 Avenue

An Apartment/Condo building in Sullivan Station, built 2013: current listings record sub-type Apartment/Condo, 4 storeys, frame-wood construction with brick and fibre-cement exterior, freehold strata title, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, guest suite and landscaped courtyard; one listing credits Porte Communities as builder. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked.
Streets, schools and getting around Sullivan Station

items.t: Sullivan Station is a residential sub-area of the City of Surrey, in the Newton community. It is the SnapStats / board sub-area name for this ground in the September 2026 report; the City does not publish a separate "Sullivan Station" plan boundary — the City names in this ground are "Sullivan," "Sullivan Heights" and "South Newton." A City boundary line for Sullivan Station itself: UNVERIFIED.

Plan ground: the South Newton plan area is approximately 485 hectares (1,200 acres), generally located north of Hwy 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street, bordered by the East Newton NCPs to the northwest. The City names two neighbourhood commercial nodes for South Newton: Panorama Heights at 152 Street and Hwy 10, and Sullivan Heights at 64 Ave and 144 Street. Nearby areas: Panorama Ridge (south), East Newton (northwest), West Newton (west), Cloverdale (east).

Plan status — read this before relying on any older plan document: the South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update and is no longer in effect; development in this area is led by the Official Community Plan, and on December 2, 2024 Council endorsed Corporate Report R246, which updated land use designations to reflect current market conditions.
Surrey community medians (sub-area medians are not published: UNVERIFIED at sub-area level): detached $1,215,000; attached $512,944, $491/sq ft, 99% sale-to-list, 25 days on market.

SD36 runs K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary, with no middle-school tier. Catchments are address-based through the SD36 School Locator; no locator result for a Sullivan Station address was run, so the catchment school for any specific address is UNVERIFIED.

Transit: buses on the 152 St and 64 Ave corridors serve this ground — route 321 runs via 152 St and King George Blvd, and route 322 runs via 132 St and 64 Ave between Newton and Scottsdale; the R1 RapidBus runs on King George Boulevard west of the area. No SkyTrain station is inside Sullivan Station. Route-level confirmation for a specific street: UNVERIFIED against a TransLink timetable.

Creeks: South Newton is home to several important fish-bearing creeks, including the headwaters of Archibald Creek, Sullivan Heights Creek and several tributaries of Hyland Creek — riparian/setback rules can apply to creek-side lots in this ground.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sullivan Station

items.t: The plan most listing copy still cites no longer exists. The South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update; the governing documents are now OCP Bylaw No. 21900 and Zoning Bylaw No. 12000, with designations updated by Corporate Report R246 on December 2, 2024. Any marketing that quotes "the South Newton NCP" as current is quoting a dead plan.

"Sullivan Station" is a board name, not a City plan name. The City's own names for this ground are Sullivan, Sullivan Heights and South Newton, and the City publishes no Sullivan Station boundary — searches run under only the board name miss City documents filed under the other three.
Both verified apartment buildings stand on the same block pair.

A brand-new school redrew the catchment conversation in January 2026. Snokomish Elementary opened that month drawing students from four existing Sullivan-area elementaries and taking over Woodward Hill's French Immersion program — pre-2026 catchment assumptions for any address here are stale.
The secondary school is also a performing-arts venue.
Attached sellers compete in a deep local pool.

No hospital sits inside the sub-area. The serving facilities are Surrey Memorial Hospital, 13750 96 Ave, and the Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre, 6830 King George Blvd — both west/northwest of the Sullivan ground.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sullivan Station

items.t: Form B diligence (all 10 strata complexes above): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Flood and creeks: the Serpentine lowlands lie south of Highway 10; no floodplain or ALR designation inside Sullivan Station itself was confirmed on a City page read for the research — a specific property's ALR status is confirmed in the Agricultural Land Commission's maps. South Newton's fish-bearing creeks (Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek, Hyland Creek tributaries) carry riparian/setback rules that can limit building envelopes on creek-side lots.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sullivan Station

items.t: The "Sullivan" 55+ complex is not in Sullivan Station — and is not a strata. Sullivan Mews (15020 66A Ave) is filed by MLS under East Newton and is a membership purchase (cash only per its listing, monthly fee covering taxes, heat, electricity, management, insurance and water). The name, the sub-area and the tenure all mislead in different directions.

Two Polygon phases share one clubhouse story. The Uplands (2005) and Oaklands (2006–2007) listings both market the same 10,000 sq ft Panorama Place clubhouse (outdoor pool, hot tub, gyms, theatre room, guest suites) — a buyer comparing the two phases is comparing unit and strata finances, not amenity sets.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 128 condos and townhomes listed in Sullivan Station. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Station a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Sullivan Station had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Station from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 84 condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Station over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Sullivan Station sell for?
faq.a: 180 townhomes sold in Sullivan Station between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $785,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Station mostly condos or townhouses?
What plan governs Sullivan Station now?
faq.a: The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 21900) and Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. The South Newton plan that covered this ground was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update and is no longer in effect; Corporate Report R246 (endorsed December 2, 2024) updated the designations.

faq.q: Is Viva a presale or a finished building?
faq.a: Newly completed, with conflicting completion dates in the sources (presale record: expected March 2025; project packet: estimated January 2026; directory: built 2025; listings: 2026) — exact completion year UNCONFIRMED. The practical step is per-unit: if the unit is a developer sale, GST and REDMA apply; if it is a resale, the Form B route applies and a current listing's "NO GST" line may reflect that unit's resale status.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Sullivan Station condo or townhouse long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals can still be restricted; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Sullivan Station condo?
faq.a: Six SD36 schools sit in or serve this ground — Sullivan, Cambridge, Goldstone Park and Woodward Hill elementaries, the new Snokomish Elementary, and Sullivan Heights Secondary (6248 144 St, approximately 1,550 students in grades 8–12, with the Bell Performing Arts Centre on site). Assignment is by home address through the SD36 School Locator, and no catchment is asserted here without a locator run.

faq.q: Can I rent out my Sullivan Station townhouse?
faq.a: Long-term, yes under provincial law: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022, even where a directory still prints "rentals allowed with restrictions" (Panorama West Coast, The Uplands).

faq.q: Is there a 55+ townhouse in Sullivan Station?
Brooklyn Village — how many units, and can I have two dogs?
faq.a: The fresh-verified feature sheet records 119 total units in strata plan EPS2076, Title to Land: Freehold Strata. A current listing record states cats OK, dogs OK, number limit two, pets allowed with restrictions (listing data — the registered bylaws on the Form B govern).
